# Agent-Ready Web Profile (ARWP)

> ARWP is an evidence-backed interoperability resolver for discovering how a public website can actually be used by software and AI agents across ordinary web discovery, llms.txt, structured data, APIs, Agent Skills, MCP, A2A and related surfaces.

This is the canonical English agent-routing surface for the ARWP project.
Canonical technical language: English (`en`).
Localized routing surfaces are available in German (`de`) and Russian (`ru`). They translate discovery context and search vocabulary, not protocol identifiers or normative technical contracts.

## Start here

- [ARWP Resolver](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/): Public project page and resolver workflow.
- [Resolver model](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/RESOLVER.md): How heterogeneous discovery evidence is normalized, compared and routed.
- [Profile specification](https://github.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/blob/main/SPEC.md): Experimental ARWP profile contract. Treat this English document as normative for project-defined semantics.
- [Conformance](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/CONFORMANCE.md): What ARWP conformance does and does not assert.
- [AI Search & Citation Profile](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/AI-SEARCH-PROFILE.md): Reusable implementation profile for original research, answer pages, evidence, comparisons, observability and citation-oriented discovery surfaces.

## Machine-readable project surfaces

- [ARWP self-profile](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/ai/site-profile.json): Project identity, data surfaces, MCP servers, trust metadata and project extensions.
- [AI Search & Citation Profile JSON](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/ai/ai-search-profile.json): Current implementation state and P0/P1/P2 citation-surface plan for ARWP itself.
- [AI Search Profile schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/main/schema/ai-search-profile.schema.json): Validation contract for copying the same implementation profile to other sites.
- [Locale manifest](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/ai/locales.json): Available agent-routing languages, canonical language and fallback policy.
- [Public directory](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/directory.json): Reference/adoption registry exposed as JSON.
- [Directory statistics](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/stats.json): Aggregate public declaration counts without visitor tracking.
- [Product history JSON](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/history.json): Machine-readable development timeline and current project status.

## Reusable AI search / citation program

ARWP now carries a non-normative profile that can be applied to other sites. It tracks implementation status rather than producing a readiness score.

The profile covers:

- direct answer pages for recurring questions;
- original research and negative results;
- a dated protocol observatory;
- protocol comparison pages;
- canonical concept definitions;
- stable claim identifiers and evidence receipts;
- an AI/search crawler matrix;
- reproducible experiments about which surfaces agents actually fetch;
- a machine-readable knowledge graph;
- reusable citation visuals;
- external distribution with one canonical source;
- AI/search citation and referral measurement;
- localization and product history.

`planned` means intended work and must not be interpreted as a deployed capability. `active` means the surface is currently published or operated.

- [English / canonical](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/llms.txt): Canonical agent-routing text.
- [Deutsch](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/de/llms.txt): German discovery and routing descriptions; technical contracts remain canonical in English.
- [Русский](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/ru/llms.txt): Russian discovery and routing descriptions; technical contracts remain canonical in English.
- [Localization policy](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/LOCALIZATION.md): Language selection, fallback and identifier-preservation rules.

## Boundaries

ARWP is not an SEO ranking mechanism, permission layer, replacement for MCP/A2A/OAuth/OpenAPI, or proof that an undeclared runtime capability exists. The AI Search & Citation Profile is likewise not a guarantee of inclusion, citation or ranking in any search/AI product. Prefer observed and protocol-native evidence, publish original useful material, preserve source authority and negative results, and keep planned surfaces distinct from active ones. When a localized routing surface and the canonical English technical documentation differ, use the canonical English technical documentation for project-defined semantics.
